svg.title: Ewa Freighter - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 18-19, PDF 19-20. Aligned middle cargo and lower accommodation/engineering decks share the same exterior: rounded rectangular forebody, broad rounded aft shoulders and stepped flat stern. Smaller upper fuel deck is contained. Illustration corroborates rounded narrow nose and broad rear machinery. Crane/cargo openings remain solid hull projection, no room borders included.
